moni.quest.0002BA59214CE34A.description1: &6Silicone&r em forma de sólido é necessário para produzir &6Transistores&r, que são necessários para &6Circuitos HV&r. Note que a receita para &6Barra de Silicone&r pede por &d2.273 K&r. É por isso que fizemos &6Bobinas de Kanthal&r mais cedo - &6 Bobinas de Cuproníquel&r não conseguem alcançar essa temperatura.
moni.quest.0002BA59214CE34A.description2: Esquentando diretamente &6Pó de Silicone&r que você consegue Eletrolisando vários materiais é uma opção, mas é lento e consome muita energia. Um método alternativo é obtendo &6Pó de Sílica&r reutilizando o &6Vidro&r que você está produzindo, e esquentando com &6Pó de Carbono&r. Isso produz &6Barras de Silicone &6mais de 5x&r mais rápido, sobrando &eMónoxido de Carbono&r para uso em vários processos químicos.
moni.quest.0006FEA1843FEA0A.description1: Simular a morte de criaturas vai de vez em quando ocasionar em &6Previsões&r daquele tipo de criatura.
moni.quest.0006FEA1843FEA0A.description2: Colocar &6Previsões de Criaturas&r num &3Fabricador de Espólios&r vai ter permitir obter um de vários itens relacionados àquela criatura.
moni.quest.0006FEA1843FEA0A.description3: Diferentemente da &3Câmara de Simulação&r, Fabricadores de Espólios possuem &alados&r, aceitando itens do &atopo&r e permitindo extração de &atodos os outros lados exceto o topo&r.
moni.quest.00203B07F8A930DA.description1: Isso mesmo, você pode fabricar &6Estrelas do Nether&r. Legal, né?
moni.quest.00203B07F8A930DA.description2: Ao longo do pack, Estrelas do Nether vão ser necessárias em quantidades que excedem a capacidade de algum jogador farmar os Withers. &eFabrique-as, nem tente farmar.

moni.quest.01F946C4A4BF4FFE.description2: Não se preocupe se não conseguir fazê-los por um tempo. Você provavelmente os conseguirá por volta do tensão IV.

moni.quest.025543EDB0A4AC22.description2: Este material é frequentemente usado em equipamentos eletrônicos e digitais.

moni.quest.0381DCD3FD3C9ED2.description1: Um &6Circuito Programado&r é um item usado para configurar máquinas. Em essência, eles dizem a uma máquina o que fazer se houver várias coisas que ela poderia fazer a partir de uma determinada entrada.
moni.quest.0381DCD3FD3C9ED2.description2: Por exemplo, o &3Moinho de arame&r produz diferentes espessuras de &6fios&r dependendo da configuração - &ecircuito 1&r produz &61x fios&r, &ecircuito 4&r produz &64x fios&r, etc. A receita &eEMI&r informará qual configuração de circuito é necessária.
moni.quest.0381DCD3FD3C9ED2.description3: Cada barramento de entrada de máquina e item vem com um &2"circuito fantasma" gratuito&r. Clique no slot do circuito no &9canto inferior esquerdo&r da GUI para configurar este circuito fantasma.
moni.quest.0381DCD3FD3C9ED2.description4: Dito isso, o item Circuito Programado (criado a partir de um único &6LV Circuit&r) ainda tem suas utilidades:
moni.quest.0381DCD3FD3C9ED2.description5: - Enquanto segura um circuito programado, pressione Shift e clique com o botão direito na máquina para definir um &bCircuito Fantasma&r da mesma configuração no slot de circuito da máquina.
moni.quest.0381DCD3FD3C9ED2.description6: - Quando você tiver certeza de que os itens que você colocou em uma máquina não terão conflitos, você pode colocar &evárias configurações de circuito&r em uma máquina, e ela será capaz de lidar com receitas que pedem qualquer uma dessas configurações. Isso é útil para máquinas como a &3Alloy Blast Smelter&r, mas você não encontrará isso por um tempo.
moni.quest.0381DCD3FD3C9ED2.title: &9Circuitos Programados
moni.quest.038D06BCA022C1BF.description1: &3Extratores&r são úteis para derreter coisas em líquidos. Por exemplo, você pode derreter lingotes em metais fundidos, ou &6Folhas de Borracha&r em &9Borracha&r líquida.
moni.quest.038D06BCA022C1BF.description2: Você pode fazer moldes de &6Aço&r e usar &3Solidificadores de Fluidos&r para formar vários componentes de forma mais eficiente a partir de fluidos, como &6Engrenagens&r.
moni.quest.038D06BCA022C1BF.subtitle: &2As funções do Extrator e do Extrator de Fluidos foram combinadas em uma única máquina!
moni.quest.038D06BCA022C1BF.title: &2Extrator
moni.quest.039F70814051413E.description1: "&6Ovos de Dragão&r?" Você pode perguntar. Sim.
moni.quest.039F70814051413E.description3: Os Micro Mineradores de Nível Seis são a primeira opção para obter alguns ovos (o suficiente para esta missão, por sinal). Mais tarde, você também obterá quantidades substanciais dos Micro Mineradores de Nível Oito enquanto acumula &6Escamas de Dragão&r.
moni.quest.039F70814051413E.title: Quebrando alguns ovos
moni.quest.040B3FCD82533BD9.description1: Dobrar as leis da física não é pouca coisa. Felizmente, você criou uma solução compacta o suficiente para caber em um Micro Minerador.
moni.quest.040B3FCD82533BD9.description2: Como você provavelmente pode imaginar, eles são caros.
moni.quest.040B3FCD82533BD9.subtitle: Manuseie com cuidado: pode destruir o universo.
moni.quest.040B3FCD82533BD9.title: &9Composto de pulsar ômnico estabilizado em campo
moni.quest.04475771966A92C3.description1: An advanced ingredient used for the &aUltimate Extended Crafting Table&r and other late-game recipes.
moni.quest.04A0863937695AC4.description3: The &aGregTech Wrench&r is used to rotate GregTech machines and redefine their output sides. &2It also has some of the capabilities of the other Wrenches now.&r
moni.quest.04BDE09518C184E4.description1: &9Naphtha&r is best utilized for Steam-Cracking and distilling for its constituents.
moni.quest.0508D3CCB6C876A3.description3: The first option is to process ores from the &6Tier Five Micro Miner&r. &6Naquadah Ore&r yields Nq+ (through the &3Magnetic Separator&r) and &6Kaemanite Ore&r yields Ke.
moni.quest.0523F4AB9A794390.description1: &2Certain multiblocks in CEu will require a Maintenance Hatch and/or Muffler Hatch. &cThese cannot be shared between multiblocks. &2If you knew Maintenance in GT5u, fret not - Maintenance mechanics are far less punishing in CEu.
moni.quest.0523F4AB9A794390.description3: - &aMaintenance&r: You will need to do Maintenance for the Multiblock to begin operating. This is done by having a &9Wrench&r, a &9Screwdriver&r, a &9Soft Mallet&r, a &9Hammer&r, a &9Wire Cutter&r, and a &9Crowbar&r in your inventory, opening the Maintenance Hatch and &eclicking the center spot once&r. &cNo need to move tools individually&r. Alternatively, you can fix problems by placing &9Tape&r in the Maintenance Hatch.
moni.quest.053DDDCD2505E20B.description1: &9JEAN Gasoline is the most powerful combustion fuel, using some anomalous ingredients to generate a staggering 81920 EU per mB of fuel. The trade-off is the extremely complex processing lines you must set up for it.
moni.quest.061904A6FEED5B66.description1: &6Chromium&r is used in the production of many alloys. &6Stainless Steel&r, &6Vanadiumsteel&r, and &6Kanthal&r are the ones you will encounter soon.
moni.quest.077AA27F26B7831F.description2: Although there are several types of rechargeable batteries you can make, &2Lithium Batteries&r are the best ones, and the only ones you should really consider making.
moni.quest.07D45A3F8A74A61C.description2: &2GTCEu now has Mining Hammers natively! You can craft them with any GT tool material. &r
moni.quest.0889C9E0DD0FDF06.description1: The &6Naquadah-doped Boule&r produces even more wafers per boule. It also is relatively cheap, due to the abundance of Naquadah that is gained from the &eTier 5 Micro Miner Mission&r.
moni.quest.0889C9E0DD0FDF06.description2: This boule also allows the production of &6Advanced System-on-Chip&r wafers, which are used to make the final forms of &6Quantum&r and &2Nanocircuits&r very cheaply. However, you might not be able to take advantage of the &6Advanced System-on-Chip&r yet, due to the power requirements.
moni.quest.08948A23B3A17923.description1: &9LaserIO&r's energy cards can be upgraded with &6Energy Overclockers&r to allow them to transport energy. &eNote that only the extracting card requires an overclocker!&r
moni.quest.08B36E2C37C417E5.description4: To make Silicone Rubber, you will need to create &6Polydimethylsiloxane Dust&r in one of several ways, then mix it with &6Sulfur&r in a &3Chemical Reactor&r. You can then coat wires with it in an &3Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.098CF1FD284B09E7.description1: Better fuel means you need to use less of it.
moni.quest.09C0CDC1DFA7842D.description1: &2Pumps are now available in GT. Useful for gathering Oil or perhaps Lava from the Nether.
moni.quest.0B6196692F9E176D.description1: &2Double Plates&r used for the Tier Seven Micro Miner.
moni.quest.0B9D5F865C3F8B31.description1: Made by adding some Iridium and Osmium to your HSS-G.
moni.quest.0BB798ACFE684AA9.description1: With your &2Rhodium Plated Lumium-Palladium&r-based machine hulls, Assembling Machine built, and &6Quantum Processor Mainframes&r squared away, you can finally get on the path to making a Ludicrous Voltage &3Circuit Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.0BB798ACFE684AA9.description2: This tier of Assembling Machine unlocks &6Crystal Circuits&r, as well as handling crafting recipes up to 32768 EU/t. It can also optionally overclock recipes that consume up to 8192 EU/t for improved speed at the cost of relatively more power.
moni.quest.0C08F09EBCDFDAD0.description2: These Crafting Units can be crafted with &eMEGA Cell Storage Components&r to make even larger crafting units, or can be crafted with &6Engineering Processors&r and &6Standard AE2 Storage Components&r to make denser &9Crafting Co-Processors&r.
moni.quest.0C10EC03A01E7334.description5: The exact implementation is up to you. Make use of the various LV and MV machines you have, and look through &bEMI&r and the Renewable Production tab for the ways to get infinite sources of each ingredient (like &aEnderman Models&r for pearls).
moni.quest.0C173EF148EFEF8E.description2: These are quests for a full stack of many of the materials in the game. Those are the materials you'll need to synthesize &6Omnium&r, the basic endgame resource. It's the pack's way of letting you know what materials you should be prepared to mass produce as you approach the end.
moni.quest.0C4E18B05F9E68DE.description1: &2The next tier of Assembling Machine. This one can make quite a few nice things - check the surrounding quests.
moni.quest.0D0A0C18ED958511.description1: Mixing &9Diesel&r (or less efficiently, &9Bio Diesel&r) with &9Tetranitromethane&r in an &3HV Mixer&r &2or Large Chemical Reactor&r produces &2Cetane-Boosted Diesel&r, an extremely potent fuel needed later for &6Cryolobus&r production.
moni.quest.0D6C8FFD01BE5C21.description4: Remember that Hatches and Buses can be replaced by Hatches and Buses of any tier, although the Input Bus must be at least LV, as there are 2 inputs, and that you can &6sneak-right click&r the controller to enable the in-world preview.
moni.quest.0DE9B264A3BA75BB.rich_descrip: , allowing for quick, customizable, and easy sorting of any inventory! The keybind is
moni.quest.0E010F5348FC89BF.description2: It can be electrolyzed easily from &6Sphalerite&r (which also provides &6Gallium&r), &6Cinnabar&r, and &6Pyrite&r. Alternately, Sulfur can be acquired through &bHNN&r- look into that quest line if you haven't already.
moni.quest.0E419DD2C6D58F49.description1: Bits of a &6Blizz Rod&r. Using a &3Macerator&r doubles your yield.
moni.quest.0ED041E2114F7C84.description2: This material is primarly made up of a &6Sculk Microstructure Pulp&r and a bit &6Prussian Blue&r, and is activated in a discharger.
moni.quest.0EDFB0C24B9129AB.description1: &2This isn't new in CEu either, but in this version, you will use this to break Cobblestone into Gravel and Gravel into Sand. It's also used to combine 2 Rods into 1 Long Rod.
moni.quest.0EF85170074E70B3.description5: &6* Co-Processing Units&r, which are used to craft multiple things at once. These are optional.
moni.quest.0EF85170074E70B3.description9: Finally, you'll need a &6Pattern&r. In order to make this, put empty &6Patterns&r in the &6Pattern Encoding Terminal&r, and find the recipe in &bEMI&r, while still in the &6Pattern Encoding Terminal&r. Then, click '+' in &bEMI&r, and press the arrow to encode the recipe. This goes in the &6Pattern Provider&r that you set up in the last step. You can use &6Pattern Access Terminals&r to access &6Pattern Providers'&r pattern slots.
moni.quest.0F6B344C265D1FBB.description1: Each craft in an &3LuV Chemical Reactor&r takes five minutes, so it's probably a good idea to have more than one machine running this recipe. At least you're guaranteed &264 from a craft.
moni.quest.0F779BEEED8E67BB.description1: &2Large Turbines have been improved in CEu. They are quite complex to run, but can generate lots of power when done well and scale very well.&r
moni.quest.0FD9B533BB402B17.description1: Using a Shattered Microverse and a &6Tier Eleven Micro Miner&r, &6Alien Scrap&r can be retrieved. Scrap can be sifted into various bits of ruined tech, each of which go through their own miniature processing line to be recycled into &6Necrosiderite&r.
moni.quest.0FF18D13CD42F48A.description3: &2GTCEu has a Primitive Water Pump, which can do it faster. However, it requires Treated Wood, which requires Creosote from a Coke Oven.
moni.quest.1040D941027962B1.description1: &aME Pattern Providers&r and &aME Interfaces&r are extremely important for automation. You'll be making a lot of these, if you're playing the pack right.
moni.quest.1175ED9EF0AB82F6.description5: You can equip these as a bauble, and use a hotkey to open them. Search 'Applied Energistics' as a &ecategory&r to see and edit these hotkeys.
moni.quest.1175ED9EF0AB82F6.description7: &9Building Gadgets can be bound to the ME system by &8Shift-right-clicking&9 with it on an online ME Wireless Access Point.&r
moni.quest.11FDFB08CD48D66E.description1: The MAX voltage lacks machines to call its own, with the primary usage of its circuits being to craft the &9Creative Quantum Chest&r.
moni.quest.1207189AD233A746.description1: &6Nano CPUs&r are advanced &6Circuit Wafers&r made from infusing a &6CPU Wafer&r with &6Carbon Fibers&r and &9Energized Glowstone&r in a &3Chemical Reactor&r.
moni.quest.1229234A71CE0A99.description1: &6Redstone&f: Found only deep in the world, in massive veins paired with &6Cinnabar&f and &6Ruby&f.
moni.quest.1229234A71CE0A99.description2: &6Copper&f: Two primary sources. &6Azurite&f veins are higher up, while &6Chalcopyrite&f veins are lower, paired with some small amounts of &6Iron&f. You'll also find &6Malachite&f inside of Iron veins, this is another type of copper ore.

moni.quest.1229234A71CE0A99.description4: &6Coal&f: Found in relatively shallow depths. &6Lignite Coal&f is &2removed.
moni.quest.1229234A71CE0A99.description5: &6Gold&f: Found inside of &6Magnetite&f veins, close to the surface.
moni.quest.126772F682B282E4.description5: - &2Nether Air&r, which can be distilled for useful gases
moni.quest.1289F9FE461BFE01.description1: &6Wetware Processors&r are made in a &cZPM&r+ &3Circuit Assembler&r still.
moni.quest.12B95158E4C792DB.description2: More advanced types of cables will require an &3Assembling Machine&f and liquid &9Rubber&f, but you can do it the simple way for now.
moni.quest.12B95158E4C792DB.description3: &2CEu has GT6-style pipes and cables on by default. &rYou will need to use &aWire Cutters&r to connect each side of a cable to machines or other cables. Placing it against the machine or cable automatically connects it as well. The same behaviour follows for GT pipes, whose tool is the &aWrench&r.
moni.quest.12B95158E4C792DB.description5: &2GT cables now support RF conversion natively! &eYou can plug an &9RF&e machine into an &9EU&e cable directly and it will convert the energy.&r You cannot, however, plug an &9RF&r power source directly into an &9EU&r cable.
moni.quest.1349FBBCE3041081.description1: Break up your &6Sandstone&r into &6Saltpeter&r. This is probably the best way to get &6Saltpeter&r, which you'll need a lot of for &6Aerotheum Dust&r. You can also get &6Saltpeter&r from &bHostile Neural Networks&r.
moni.quest.13578427FD9CC2CE.subtitle: The final Micro Miner!
moni.quest.13578427FD9CC2CE.title: &9Tier Twelve Micro Miner
moni.quest.13B12457AA9BF90D.description1: A much more efficient version of the &3Empowerer&r.
moni.quest.13B12457AA9BF90D.description2: This is a digital upgrade to the &3Crafting Core&r, allowing you to craft Empowerer recipes directly through &bPackagedAuto&r.
moni.quest.13B12457AA9BF90D.description5: These recipes require large amounts of RF and it &ewill not use power from your &aME Network&r, so you must also connect the package crafter directly to energy cards.
moni.quest.14F1FF4656693711.description2: &6Tungsten Carbide&r is a very dense, sturdy, and heat-resistant material useful for a variety of applications.
moni.quest.15372CBC9F2EA9BC.description4: If you haven't set one up yet or want to improve your setup, routing through AE is an alternative way to using LaserIO. Simply set a Tag Storage Bus on the input bus of the freezer, set it to 'forge:hot_ingots', and set it to a high priority. This will accept any new Hot Ingots entering your system, and eliminates the need for a network.
moni.quest.15372CBC9F2EA9BC.description5: Don't encode the Hot Ingot in a pattern though!
moni.quest.15DBB22E3DC0AFB7.description2: All of the Tier Four missions require &64 Quantum Flux&r and 16 &6Petrotheum Dust&r.
moni.quest.15DBB22E3DC0AFB7.description3: This miner is the first convenient source of &6Sheldonite&r, the best choice for creating &6Platinum Group Sludge&r, via a mission requiring &6Wither Realm Data&r.
moni.quest.15DBB22E3DC0AFB7.title: &9Tier Four Micro Miner
moni.quest.15E34DEC491FAB81.description2: While you can make these in a crafting table with &6Polyethylene Sheets&r, liquid &9Polyethylene&r can be used to craft these directly in an &3Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.15FAEE3F625265F4.description3: This will be required in large quantities for &6Trinium Coils&r, &6Superconducting Coil Blocks&r, and &6Naquadah Alloy&r, among other things. You will need at least 5.5 stacks for a &3Fusion Reactor MK I&r, so stock up on it!
moni.quest.17312BF0197B87A8.description2: &9Steel is one of these alloys, being made by mixing Wrought Iron dust with Coal dust or Charcoal dust&r. &2Steel forms the basis of LV Machine Hulls&r, and allows you to make &6Belt Pouches&r for upgrading your &eTool Belt&r.
moni.quest.cobblestone.description:
The best source of &6Cobblestone&r is &bThermal &6Igneous Extruders&r. If the first one isn't enough, you can always upgrade and make more of them.&r This is the starting point of your &eCobbleworks&r.

Also a cheap building block.
moni.quest.18D8D18C4494C587.description2: - &aDiode&r: A block which accepts energy on 5 sides, and outputs it on a single side. Its main purpose is to limit Amperage flow through it - adjust it by right-clicking it with a Soft Hammer, &2and to transport power into Cleanrooms.&r Not to be confused with the Diodes used as crafting components.
moni.quest.18D8D18C4494C587.description3: - &aTransformer&r: A block which changes between 4A of a lower voltage and 1A of a voltage one tier higher.
moni.quest.18D8D18C4494C587.description4: - &2Adjustable Transformer&r: Similar to the Transformer, but can be configured to transform up to 64A Low <-> 16A High.
moni.quest.18D8D18C4494C587.description5: - &aBattery Buffer&r: A block which can hold GregTech Batteries. Each battery accepts up to 2A and can provide up to 1A. &2They have been reworked in CEu to not be as terrible to use.
moni.quest.19233A97579E0BDD.description2: &2Polarizer recipes in GTCEu go up to UV.
moni.quest.193B7038EAB6EFA3.title: &9Gregtech Rocketery
moni.quest.19C2D208A2FC9968.description2: All mission require &68 Quantum Flux&r and either &624 or 32 Aerotheum Dust&r.
moni.quest.19C2D208A2FC9968.description3: This Micro miner can be used to more efficiently gather &6Mob Drops&r than the &9Tier 2.5 Micro Miner&r
moni.quest.1A427A8CB43C8B59.description1: - &lDetector&2: Available in Item, Fluid, Energy, Activity, and Advanced Activity flavours. Emits a Redstone signal depending on the status of whatever it's detecting.
moni.quest.1AA0A089DCA17FC8.description1: Placing a &9Wireless Charger&r in a area that you frequent (such as where you do your crafting) will ensure that your items are always topped off on energy.
moni.quest.1B86EF5A24286787.description2: Make the Tool Belt, and you can use the keybind (default is &6R&r), while the belt is in your inventory or Bauble Slots &cand you are holding something, or the belt is not empty&r, to open its GUI.
moni.quest.1B86EF5A24286787.description4: The Tool Belt is equippable as a &bBauble&r. Open your inventory and look for the Baubles button, then click it to reveal the additional bauble slots menu, and put it in the Belt Slot. Or, if you can't tell which bauble slot looks like a belt, just click in every bauble slot until it goes in.
moni.quest.1B86EF5A24286787.description5: The Tool Belt can store anything with a stack size of 1, like swords, pickaxes, &bGregTech&r tools, and the &6Terminal&r. It has also been modified a bit, so it also allows any &bStorage Drawers&r key, and &cdoesn't allow any Thermal Satchel&r.
moni.quest.1B86EF5A24286787.subtitle: &2A brand new and highly requested mod to CEu to help you manage your tools!&r
moni.quest.1BC6DDC2D50F9C46.description2: Since smelting &6Aluminium&r requires MV power, you're going to have to power this with 2 LV Energy Input Hatches.
moni.quest.1BC6DDC2D50F9C46.description7: You'll most likely want to locate your power quite near to the EBF. It is very power hungry, and if it cannot get enough energy, progress on the current item smelting will start to regress. Be careful to ensure the EBF has enough power, and keep a Soft Hammer nearby to pause it by tapping the controller if you run out of power.
moni.quest.1BC6DDC2D50F9C46.description8: &2In GTCEu, all hatches except Maintenance and Parallel Control can be shared between Multiblocks!
moni.quest.1CA6D620309F2B9E.description2: You can automate grains of infinity using a &3Rock Breaker&r at a low Y coordinate with &6Lava&r and &6Fluid of the Void&r adjcent to the machine. You could alternatively use a &3Rock Cycle Simulator&r to bypass the fluid adjacency requirements.
moni.quest.1CB14AC299A8EDD9.description1: The &6Machine Controller&r is a cover that manages the operation of &bGregTech&r machines, similar to a &aSoft Hammer&r. These are crucial for &epassive automation&r, where a machine is dedicated to keeping something in stock for you.
moni.quest.1CC092A2F2CD4589.description3: There are several ways to make Cryolobus: dust can be smelted into ingots, but you can also turn &6Warden Tendrils&r, which contain Cryolobus, directly into ingots. It uses a lot of combustion fuel, but is the most efficient way to craft cryolobus.
moni.quest.1D0DF2330B113B7A.description4: One option is to use the output tanks of the Chemical Reactors as a small storage buffer, letting it back up and stop crafting automatically. A &aFluid Storage Bus&r on the machine will expose the fluid to your ME Network. Whenever you need some of this fluid, your AE2 system will pull the needed fluid out and the machine will resume processing.
moni.quest.1D0DF2330B113B7A.description5: There's some catches with this approach though. First is that the inaccessible input tanks will also show up in AE but you won't be able to access them. You will want to set the Storage Bus to &eExport Only&r so AE doesn't try to store random fluids in the Chemical Reactor, and you may want to &ereduce the priority&r of the Storage Bus as well: this will signal to AE that you want it to remove fluids from that location first. Also, if multiple fluids are produced, &ethe machine will not resume processing if it doesn't have room for all fluid outputs&r.
moni.quest.1D3A5DCCE1B40D29.description1: These are the basic cables used by &3Applied Energistics&r to transport network connectivity. Due to the fact that channels are disabled, these cables will be your main method of transporting network connectivity, rather than the dense cables.
moni.quest.1DFF7C35B5B26B80.description1: Nothing you haven't seen here: just combine some standard circuit components and &6Nanocircuits&r to make a &6Nanoprocessor&r.
moni.quest.1F101D4F758ACECB.description1: With the &3Advanced Circuit Assembling Machine&r, a new theme of Circuits is available.
moni.quest.1F7FD354C79771A1.description3: The MV version is required for cutting &6Silicon Boules&r for easier &6Diodes&r once you get &9Polyethylene (PE)&r, and for cutting &6Wafers&r into usable components.
moni.quest.1F7FD354C79771A1.description4: The blade will require you to make &2Vanadiumsteel&r.
moni.quest.1FF5C2A3CAB76088.description1: Nothing new here, just use more standard circuit stuff and you can upgrade several &6Quantum Circuits&r into a &6Quantum Processor&r.
moni.quest.20745EB9A695E365.description2: Energy in the Laser Network flows from &aLaser Sources&r through &6Laser Transmitting Cables&r to &aLaser Targets&r. All these must be in a straight line - lasers don't bend, after all. Similarly to other power-related blocks, the tier of the &aLaser Target&r must not be lower than the tier of the &aLaser Source&r.
moni.quest.21B16C005E9E3B0E.description1: All &9Overclocks&r in the &3LCR&r are &6100%% efficient&r; each overclock will &5quadruple the speed&r, as opposed to doubling it.
moni.quest.2341171A4123D584.description1: This works like the pattern access terminal, but can also &9search for patterns&r, and &9highlight interfaces in world&r.
moni.quest.235C1E5B2C58B5AF.description2: They come exclusively from Tier Eight Micro Miners. You'll need the Tier Seven Micro Miner for the &6Lair of the Warden Data&r.
moni.quest.248ABB7F26EB72EE.description1: &9Optical Circuits&r and those that follow it are far more expensive than previous circuit themes, requiring silicon chips imbued with &6Neutronium&r.
moni.quest.27A80F018F59EF1E.description2: This one takes a significant amount of time to cook, so make sure to have it going constantly.
moni.quest.27EBB5AAF8A40F3D.title: &9Tier Ten Micro Miner
moni.quest.27FAD6A8FCFAB543.description1: These are easier to mass produce than &6Electronic Circuits&r, and they're required to produce the &6Advanced Integrated Circuit&r, your first &6HV&r circuit.
moni.quest.2823D7B4C8F900CA.description1: &6Stainless Steel&r will be your primary material for HV, in the same way that &6Aluminium&r was for MV and &2Steel&r was for LV.
moni.quest.2823D7B4C8F900CA.description4: You will need HV power to smelt this, which you can achieve with 2 MV Energy Hatches.
moni.quest.2861BA7C235C52A3.description1: &eSuperconductor wires won't kill you when touched now. In fact, you have to use Wires for Superconductors, because they don't even have cables!

&2There are an additional set of superconductors, one for each tier, which are the CEu default superconductors. Their advantage is their higher amperage rating, reaching the hundreds of amps for higher tier 16x wires. They are also used in crafting Field Generators. They are:
moni.quest.2977E1AF13E42DCB.description1: &2A bit of Vanadiumsteel is used for progression. It's also a very strong tool material.
moni.quest.2977E1AF13E42DCB.title: &2Vanadiumsteel
moni.quest.297B523B6C503957.description3: &aRF&r converts into &aEU&r at a &e4 to 1 ratio&r. &a100 RF&r becomes &a25 EU&r, and vice-versa. &2Use a Soft Hammer to change the conversion direction.
moni.quest.2C3C6D2038B01948.description5: &9The Multi Smelter can have its mode swapped between Electric Furnace and Alloy Smelter recipes by pressing the robot arm button in its GUI&r. Some other multiblocks use this mechanic as well.
moni.quest.2C6BEB5BBE5A91DC.description1: &2With the MV Assembling Machine, you can assemble a few necessary parts for the next Circuit tier.
moni.quest.2C6BEB5BBE5A91DC.title: &2MV Assembling Machine
moni.quest.2D0DF78F71760F00.description1: Some Micro Miner missions use a &6Gemstone Sensor&r to scout out gems instead of ores, as well as other &6rare materials&r.
moni.quest.2D10F2E538486624.description6: If the reactor stops processing, it will &erapidly lose heat&r, even if you pause it with a soft hammer. On the other hand, if the reactor is already at the required temperature for a recipe, &eno additional power&r is required to heat up the reactor! This is true even if you switch between different recipes. This mechanic incentivizes continuous use of the reactor.
moni.quest.2D31856F6EF1ED69.description3: &6Energy cards&r can be used to transfer that RF power, but the dynamo can also output RF directly into an Energy Converter by making the Excitation Coil touch the Energy Converter.
moni.quest.2D47BFA44BDB5E6A.description2: &9This Micro Miner also brings back Dragon Eggs, Dragon Scales, Dragons Breath, Quantum Stars, and Gravi-Stars&r.
moni.quest.2D47BFA44BDB5E6A.title: &9Tier Eight Micro Miner
moni.quest.2D9A95AC50BCB988.description1: &6Stabilized Microminers&r are a major milestone! These remove the need to repair your Micro Miners.
moni.quest.2DD1E2391DA3170C.description1: Upgrading to the &6Nano Supercomputer&r requires some standard circuit components and &6Lumium Wire&r.
moni.quest.2E8BFA2E719B1C47.description4: In order to proceed, you'll need to locate a source of &6Iron&f. You have a few options. &6Magnetite&f veins are higher up and contain large amounts of iron, as well as some &6Vanadium&f and &6Gold&f. Another good source of iron is &9Goethite&f veins, which contain several types of iron. Finally, &6Pyrite&f can be found paired with &6Copper&f in several types of veins.
moni.quest.2F04FA8D3E15E375.description3: In the &eOverworld&r, it can harvest: &9Oil, Light Oil, Heavy Oil, Raw Oil, Natural Gas
moni.quest.2F6EC962007FA9FB.description3: Mincemeat comes from pulverizing any kind of animal meat.
moni.quest.2F6EC962007FA9FB.description4: A &aFisher&r might be useful for this endeavor - especially &bThermal's&r &6Aquatic Entangler&r which can operate passively, produces only &6Fishes&r, and &eaccepts augments&r.
moni.quest.3D6BC54DBE665638.description2: Shift + right-click after aiming to warp to one, or point it anywhere to teleport forward a short distance (works through walls).
moni.quest.33F610CF136278AE.description1: To be able to fully harness the power of Shattered Microverses, you'll need a brand new tier of Micro Miner.
moni.quest.33F610CF136278AE.description2: This Micro Miner requires an &6Epic Extended Crafting Table&r to fit all the things required for a foray into shattered microverses.
moni.quest.33F610CF136278AE.title: &9Tier Eleven Micro Miner
moni.quest.376EE785F4204FFE.description1: &2The Sifter gets you Flawless and Exquisite Gems from Crushed Purified Gem Ores. Overall it results in a higher yield. Higher tiers of Sifter increase the yield further.
moni.quest.39D4174834F3879D.description1: The &6Steam Dynamo&r will be your source of &9power&r for the early game. It requires &9Water&r and burnable fuel like &6Coal&r or &6Sugar Cane&r to produce power.
moni.quest.3A5387B2003177B2.description3: The Flux Capacitor is a &bBauble&r, so open your inventory and look for the Baubles button, click it to reveal the additional bauble slots menu and put it into any slot you wish.
moni.quest.3AB0402B19DD5BA8.description2: If you find your power supply is faltering, you may want to make additional dynamos and turn them into steam boilers and turbines. Upgrading your dynamos is also advisable.
moni.quest.3B200AD6EFF90DFA.description1: &b&lEMI&r é a lista de todos os itens que você vê toda vez que abre seu inventário. É o livro de receitas better(tm) que mostra todos os itens e receitas disponíveis no modpack. Note que &b&lEMI&r é baseado em &b&lJEI&r, e as pessoas tendem a usar os nomes de forma intercambiável.
moni.quest.3B200AD6EFF90DFA.description2: Para vê-lo em ação, abra uma missão que exija algum tipo de item e clique no item!
moni.quest.3B200AD6EFF90DFA.rich_descrip: "Adicionar/Remover Marcador" na opção de atalho de teclado
"Mostrar receita" na opção de atalho de teclado
