moni.quest.3B3F46345D39CAE2.description1: &6Tungsten&r is a material that requires an &3EV Electrolyzer,&2 Chemical Bath&r and an &3Electric Blast Furnace&r with at least &6Nichrome Coils&r.
moni.quest.3C3B5875FCD6B5B7.description1: With your &6Crystal CPUs&r and the &dLuV &3Assembling Machine&r crafted, you can make the final type of Tier Five Circuit: the &6Crystal Processor&r.
moni.quest.3C3B5875FCD6B5B7.description3: As the best form of Tier Five circuit, these should be automated and stockpiled. The variant recipe requiring &6Crystal System-on-Chip&r won't be available until you can make a &3UV Circuit Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.3E42B4AAA6D2A05B.description1: An advanced component used for the Circuit Assembling Machine.
moni.quest.3F6EDC2481D5877F.description1: Nickel comes from several different ores, including Pentlandite and Garnierite, but they're all found in the same vein.
moni.quest.3F6EDC2481D5877F.description2: Nickel is used mostly for several very important alloys, including Invar and Cupronickel.
moni.quest.3FF918B4CF33E8F7.description1: Bits of a &6Basalz Rod&r. Using a &3Macerator&r doubles your yield.
moni.quest.410EA68D6EF15CEC.description1: A &6P2P Tunnel&r (&aPoint-to-Point Tunnel&r) is a powerful tool from &bApplied Energistics 2&r that can be used to send items, redstone, RF/EU or fluids from one location to another using your ME system, without the need to use any disk storage space. &cTransporting RF/EU has a 5%% tax on the input energy.&r
moni.quest.410EA68D6EF15CEC.description3: By default, a P2P tunnel is an &6ME tunnel&r, which transmits Applied Energistics channels and power. Since channels are disabled, you will most likely not be using the default tunnel. You can change the mode of your P2P tunnels by right clicking the tunnel with the respective item seen in &bEMI&r.
moni.quest.410EA68D6EF15CEC.title: P2P Tunnels
moni.quest.41C2E49E70D76330.description1: &2This Steam multiblock was intended for use in the Steam Age. This pack skips the Steam Age, but it may still be worth using.&r
moni.quest.41C2E49E70D76330.description2: The &6Steam Grinder&r functions as 5.3 &7LV &3Macerators&r in parallel! It requires an input of &9Steam&r through a &eSteam Hatch&r.
moni.quest.41C2E49E70D76330.description3: You may want to consider setting up a rudimentary &eore-doubling&r setup with it. Point the output in the direction of several upgraded &3Furnaces&r.
moni.quest.41FA85A3920EB334.description2: &6Enriched Naquadah&r is meant to be used in as-of-yet-unimplemented CEu-native reactors. It's used in small amounts for &3Trinium Coil blocks&r, or in Moni reactors, though Naquadria is better for that purpose.
moni.quest.425D1C34A82B054D.description2: There are three recipes the reactor can run, each of them with a different balance between power output and fuel efficiency.
moni.quest.425D1C34A82B054D.title: &9 Naquadah Reactor
moni.quest.4261BDA34D716EC8.description1: The &3Omnic Synthesizer&r…synthesizes &6Omnium&r. The Synthesizer will create one &6Omnium Nugget&r when its progress value reaches 100. Recipes run in the Synthesizer will grant exponentially more progress based on how many other unique recipes have run since that recipe.
moni.quest.431BB650AC492C84.title: &9 Machine Auto-Output
moni.quest.434142F777A2CCBE.description1: The last circuit board. These are made by wrapping &6Carbon Mesh Reinforced Circuit Boards&r with &6Null&r and some other goodies. Additionally, if you haven't made &6Living Solder&r yet, you will need to do that now.
moni.quest.441E5CDAD5007906.description2: &6&rLarger quantities of Ilmenite and Bauxite may be found on the Moon and other planets.
moni.quest.447F6F4642A36F9D.description5: The item equivalent are &3Super Chests&r, which are used in certain &6Micro Miner&r recipes.
moni.quest.44E2C12FC4C26CA9.description1: With your &2Darmstadtium&r-based machine hulls and &6Wetware Mainframes&r squared away, you can finally get on the path to making a UV &3Circuit Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.44E2C12FC4C26CA9.description2: This tier of Assembling Machine unlocks &6Optical Circuits&r, as well as handling crafting recipes up to 524288 EU/t. It can also optionally overclock recipes that consume up to 131072 EU/t for improved speed at the cost of relatively more power.
moni.quest.4685AC9E6CD87B77.description5: When reading Macerator recipes in &bEMI&r, you can tell which outputs are byproducts by seeing if &ethe tooltip tells you it has a chance to appear&r: guaranteed outputs do not list a chance. &2The chance increases by a certain amount for each tier of machine you have above the recipe's required tier. This chance is also listed in the tooltip.
moni.quest.46AF35D4EECA5BDB.description1: Needs 2 &6Water Source Blocks&r around it to generate water. You will also need a way to pull the water out of the accumulator, such as using an &5LV pump&f as a &acover&f.
moni.quest.47D092CBA484C0DE.description1: With your new &6Epoxy Circuit Boards, &6QBit CPUs&r, and some standard components, you can make the final type of Tier Four Circuit: the &6Quantum Circuit&r.
moni.quest.47D092CBA484C0DE.description2: As the best form of Tier Four circuit, these should be automated and stockpiled. The variant recipe requiring &6Advanced System-on-Chip&r won't be available until ZPM.
moni.quest.483652BAEF59E125.description1: &6Hadal Warp Engines&r are components needed for the Tier Nine and Tier Ten Micro Miners, as well as a few End Game recipes.
moni.quest.49B872B193268554.description2: This micro miner can also provide: &6Uraninite&r, &6Plutonium&r, more &6Rarest Metal Mixture&r than the &6T5MM&r, &6Ancient Debris&r, and more.
moni.quest.49B872B193268554.title: &2Tier Six Micro Miner
moni.quest.49C8716030809478.description1: The &3Crafting Core&r is used to make micro miner plating and some end-game items.
moni.quest.49D33146A1F417E8.description1: &9Radon&r will be needed in large quantities.
moni.quest.49D33146A1F417E8.description2: For now, you'll need to obtain it from Tier Two Micro Miner missions, in the form of &6Radon Salt&r. Electrolyze it for Radon and &6Rock Salt&r. &2You can also get it from distilling liquid Ender Air.&r
moni.quest.49E9A178F6A52A62.description1: With your &2Naquadah Alloy&r-based machine hulls and &6Crystal Processor Mainframes&r squared away, you can finally get on the path to making a ZPM &3Circuit Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.49E9A178F6A52A62.description2: This tier of Assembling Machine unlocks &6Wetware Circuits&r, as well as handling crafting recipes up to 131072 EU/t. It can also optionally overclock recipes that consume up to 32768 EU/t for improved speed at the cost of relatively more power.
moni.quest.4A696D4BA5442928.description1: &bArmazenamento Funcional&f fornece uma quantidade enorme de armazenamento para um único tipo de item. Use-os para coisas que você tem muito, como pedras, terra e minérios.
moni.quest.4A696D4BA5442928.description2: &9Os itens de modelo de moldura podem ser usados para decorar facilmente suas gavetas.&r
moni.quest.4A696D4BA5442928.description3: Além disso, você pode fazer coisas especiais com suas gavetas, com &9fermentas&r e &9Upgrades! Pesquise &e@Functionalstorage&r em &bEMI&r para vê-los!
moni.quest.4A696D4BA5442928.subtitle: &oEsta missão pode ser concluída com qualquer gaveta.
moni.quest.4A696D4BA5442928.title: &9Gavetas
moni.quest.4CD6C60CBEFFA317.description2: Cupronickel Coils are produced in the &3Assembler&r with &62x Cupronickel Wire&r, &6Bronze Foil&r, and &9Liquid Tin Alloy&r.
moni.quest.4DB622A78605A2EB.description1: The first and most expensive Tier Six Circuit, needed for crafting the &3IV Circuit Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.4E4F03C44623A85D.description1: The &3Helical Fusion Reactor&r is a large multiblock structure capable of fusing elements in parallel&r.
moni.quest.4E63CE9607E3B792.description1: With your &6Tungstensteel&r-based machine hulls and &6Nanoprocessor Mainframes&r squared away, you can finally get on the path to making an Insane Voltage &3Circuit Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.4E63CE9607E3B792.description2: This tier of Assembling Machine unlocks &6Quantum Circuits&r, as well as handling crafting recipes up to 8192 EU/t. It can also optionally overclock recipes that consume up to 2048 EU/t for improved speed at the cost of relatively more power.
moni.quest.4E9530E62A4B673B.description1: Refines materials into potent &6Liquid Naquadah Fuels&r.
moni.quest.4F4D0F44B615AF4C.description2: Making &aSodium Persulfate&r with &6Salt&r will yield &aHydrochloric Acid&r as a coproduct, which you may re-use to make &aIron III Chloride&r. This is the best approach right now, but the decision is entirely yours. With more automation later in the game, Iron III Chloride will be the cheaper and more straightforward path.
moni.quest.4F4F120AFB3A9250.description3: Make sure you're using an &3Assembling Machine&r to craft these things. Making them by hand isn't as efficient as the machine.
moni.quest.4FABACAB7C4A74AC.description1: Use &6Stem Cells&r and more advanced materials to build a &6Neuro Processing Unit&r. This is used in &6Wetware Processors&r.
moni.quest.500E619D568C07C2.description1: &2Technically not new to CEu, but it was disabled in the original version, and it had much less functionality in CE.&r
moni.quest.500E619D568C07C2.description2: The Arc Furnace allows you to make &6Annealed Copper&r, which will be used in the MV Age. It can also make 2 pieces of Glass from 1 Sand. Later, it can make &2Tempered Glass&r for use in higher-tier recipes.
moni.quest.500E619D568C07C2.description3: The Arc Furnace also functions as a &auniversal recycling machine&r. Pretty much anything can be recycled into ingots and dusts of its base components.
moni.quest.500E619D568C07C2.description4: All of its recipes require Oxygen.
moni.quest.508452E1A3E09B56.description1: Overclocking aside, as you continue to progress in &5Monifactory&f, materials made in the &3Electric Blast Furnace&f will take longer to complete. &eMore advanced coils allow for the furnace to &eget hot enough to process more advanced materials&f, &2and they also granting energy efficiency bonuses and speed bonuses to overclocking.&r
moni.quest.517A89E954C7EA74.description1: An &3MV Electrolyzer&r allows you to process recipes that require up to 128 EU/t, and can optionally overclock recipes costing at most 32 EU/t.
moni.quest.529D50CE814AF449.description5: For now, a &3Vacuum Chest&r should help keep the floor clean, and causes less lag than Hoppers. A &aVoid Upgrade&r in a &6Storage Drawer&r will automatically delete any items that overflow the drawer's capacity, so it's a good way to ensure you don't crash your server from accumulating a massive sugar cane pile before safer block breakers are available to you.
moni.quest.52F1953ED72A8AA6.description1: The &3Advanced Microverse Projector&r is a more powerful projector required for sending &6Tier Four&r through &6Tier Six Micro Miners&r into microverses.
moni.quest.52F1953ED72A8AA6.description3: This tier requires &6EV Field Generators&r, and therefore &6Uranium&r. You can get some from processing &6Uranium Hexafluoride&r, or quite slowly from macerating &6Red Granite&r.
moni.quest.53205E306EE07F6F.description2: You're making these in an &3Assembling Machine&r, right?
moni.quest.53347AAAE4495F95.description1: &2Initial circuit components are a bit more difficult in CEu, and you need Arsenic in addition to Gallium.&r
moni.quest.5357A16B5BF62C96.description2: It might seem crazy right now, but you'll want a dedicated &3Chemical Reactor&r for pretty much every chemical you want to process. You probably want to hold off on doing that until you've got a solid base with autocrafting though… it stings a lot less when you can just request crafts of Chemical Reactors from your AE2 system.
moni.quest.53C00EA9D9BEE776.description1: The Second Micro Miner! &2You'll need Phosphorous in its LV Field Generators.&r
moni.quest.53C00EA9D9BEE776.description2: &9Don't forget that you can automate Extended Crafting recipes before you get PackagedAuto by converting your Extended Crafting tables into autocrafting tables.
moni.quest.53C00EA9D9BEE776.title: &9Tier Two Micro Miner
moni.quest.542F0090D8975D3C.description1: Em &9Monifactory&r, todo o trânsito dimensional é feito através do poder de &6TelePastries&r. Nenhum Portal aqui!
moni.quest.542F0090D8975D3C.description2: Esta missão é repetível e dá a você um bolo grátis para o &2Overworld&r ou &7Void World&r a cada hora. Você também pode recarregar seus bolos com os itens indicados em suas dicas de ferramentas.
moni.quest.542F0090D8975D3C.description3: &cNão se esqueça de ter uma maneira de voltar!&r Se você esquecer, clique no coração Itens de Emergência no lado direito da tela do livro de missões.
moni.quest.542F0090D8975D3C.subtitle: Bolos são objetos quânticos!
moni.quest.542F0090D8975D3C.title: Trânsito dimensional baseado em bolo
moni.quest.54B7849F647CE74B.subtitle: The final Micro Miner!
moni.quest.54B7849F647CE74B.title: &9Tier Twelve Micro Miner
moni.quest.54C3B1B782FDF57F.description1: Glowing! &2But all the GTCEu machines glow already, so...&r
moni.quest.553F85782265C350.description5: &9Now that you have Quantum Entangled Singularities, put one into the&r &6Quantum Link Chamber&r&9 of the &r&aQuantum Ring&r&9, and the other in the&r &6Wireless Terminal&r!
moni.quest.5601A05D8361551D.description1: &6Extradimensional Processor Mainframes&r are unique in that there are no subsquent circuit themes, and thus no other kinds of Tier Eleven circuits.
moni.quest.5601A05D8361551D.title: &9The First Tier Eleven Circuit
moni.quest.5795EE147D4879B7.description1: &2Most plates are made in the Bender instead of here.
moni.quest.57D1B1D74391A05F.subtitle: &2Item Pipes are back in GTCEu! They will transport items instantly through them.
moni.quest.57D9FA04817CB92F.description1: A complex plating material used primarily for the Tier Nine Micro Miner.
moni.quest.58566C7BF4C22D86.description1: &6Gregtech&r adds a decent bit of extra crafting to the earlygame. Thankfully, &bEMI&r has some tools to help make your life &9&lMUCH&r easier when doing all this crafting.
moni.quest.58F73E3D1069F52C.description1: The &aME Extended Drive&r can store up to 20 Storage Disks.
moni.quest.58FCAC329B09FEB0.description1: &9Elemental Reduction Fluid&r is the main method of &6Thermal Elemental Dust&r production in Hardmode, but can also see some use in Normal Mode.
moni.quest.595F205B551A53C9.description2: &9Nitrogen Dioxide&r can be made with a simple combination of &9Nitrogen&r and &9Oxygen&r, or skipped entirely with the &3Large Chemical Reactor.&r
moni.quest.5A70898C99B828E3.description2: As an end-game structure, it is rather expensive to make. However, it is an investment that will easily pay for itself as you progress through the endgame. You should strongly consider making one of these with your first few &6Hearts Of A Universe&r.
moni.quest.5A83E1115F965393.description4: If you've opted to enable channels in your AE2 configs, you will innately have some energy storage from the &3ME Controller&r, but we assume you know what you're doing at that point. &eThe mechanics of AE2 Channels are outside the scope of the quest book, and this is the only time it will be mentioned.
moni.quest.5A8D2BFAF02E6325.description1:
Fabricate batches of previous circuits inside of miniaturized microverses and mount them to a processing unit to create the most powerful tier of circuit, Extradimensional.

&6Complex SMD Components&r are now mandatory.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description1: Unlike &aRF power&r, which is safe to transport with &bLaserIO&r, &aEU power &erequires caution&r. The key is to always &amatch or exceed&r the &eVoltage &rand&e Amperage&r of your power source with your &6cables&r and machines.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description2: &cNEVER &rhook up your Energy Converter&r to a cable that has fewer &eAmps&r than your Energy Converter or Battery Buffer generates. For example, you must use &64x cable&r for a 4A Converter&r, and &616x cable&r for a filled 16-slot Battery Buffer&r. Cables with insufficient amperage rating will &cburn and be destroyed&r. &2Both the multiple-amp-source and multiple-face-input bugs from CE have been fixed - the Energy network now works as intended.&r
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description3: Similarly, your cable must match or exceed the &eVoltage&r of your machines, or they will &cburn and be destroyed&r.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description4: &cNEVER&r connect a machine to excessive &eVoltage&r or it will &cvaporize&r. Touching a &6wire&r with connected &aEU power&r will &cinjure or kill you&r, so for your safety, &euse &6cables&e instead&r!
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description5: &2Superconductor-type wires do not damage you in CEu. The 0-loss cables in CE (Conductive Iron, Energetic Alloy, etc.) are considered Superconductors.
moni.quest.5B0200011DF8E1B6.description2: For example, you can break down Water into &9Hydrogen Gas&r and &9Oxygen Gas&r.
moni.quest.5B07A88C0BFF6586.description2: These structures are used to project &6Micro Miners&r into a &eMicroverse&r to obtain valuable loot such as &6ores&r, &6gems&r, and otherwise unobtainable items&r like &6Radium Salt&r and &6Naquadah&r. &eMost Micro Miners are &6fully reusable&r, including your first one.&r
moni.quest.5B07A88C0BFF6586.description4: A single &6HV Energy Input&r supports missions up to 1024 EU/t. To process the rest, you'll need to upgrade the multiblock to at least &eEV power&r, with either &6two HV Energy Inputs&r or &6one EV Energy Input&r. Missions will also overclock, increasing in speed each time the projector's energy tier increases and available power reaches the next multiple of four times the base mission power.
moni.quest.5B3AF79FBDF80C51.description1: This version of &aME Interface&r acts like two of them at once, allowing for 1152 items or 72 buckets of fluids.
moni.quest.5B3AF79FBDF80C51.subtitle: Neither do I, check my neighbour Extended Pattern Provider instead
moni.quest.5B9F1EE13E397DEE.description1: With your &6Titanium&r-based machine hulls and &6Mainframes&r squared away, you can finally get on the path to making an Extreme Voltage &3Circuit Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.5B9F1EE13E397DEE.description2: This tier of Assembling Machine unlocks &6Nanocircuits&r, as well as handling crafting recipes up to 2048 EU/t. It can also optionally overclock recipes that consume up to 512 EU/t for improved speed at the cost of relatively more power.
moni.quest.5C4E189A3E401566.description1: You might notice that these hulls can be made more cheaply in an &3Assembling Machine&r, but you don't have that weird fluid. Don't worry, you'll be able to make that soon.
moni.quest.5C4E189A3E401566.description2: &2Overclocking mechanics have changed in CEu. All overclocks now multiply the speed by 2.0x (instead of the 2.0/2.8 split in CE). This means that to save energy, you should build more low-tier machines over overclocking a high-tier machine, especially for passive processes.
moni.quest.5C4E189A3E401566.description3: Additionally, ULV recipes will not overclock to LV. A ≤8 EU/t recipe won't overclock at all in an LV machine, will only overclock once in an MV machine, etc.
moni.quest.5C78349343BA40D7.description3: &2In CEu, using higher-tier coils provides some bonuses to their multiblocks.&r For the &3Electric Blast Furnace&r, running recipes hotter than required can reduce the energy cost and time taken. The &9temperature&r of the EBF depends on the coil used and the voltage it is running at. For Kanthal Coils, this means that recipes you could run with &6Cupronickel Coils&r will save &95%%&r energy.
moni.quest.5ECF0A787D861C89.description2: Using your &2Neuro Processing Units&r, you can craft (grow?) these circuits in a &cZPM&r or better &3Circuit Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.5ECF0A787D861C89.description3: These are fairly slow to craft and you're going to need considerable quantities, so make sure you have a good parallelized infrastructure for keeping these stocked.
moni.quest.5F9C7FB40AD2640B.description2: Also important to note is that it won't work with Tile Entities, so it pretty much only works with simple blocks (not stuff like machines).
moni.quest.5FB696EF1D2412F5.description2: &6Fluorine&r is needed in &6Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE)&r, and &6Thorium&r is used in &bNuclearcraft: Neoteric &3Fission Reactors&r.
moni.quest.5FB696EF1D2412F5.description3: &3Rock Breakers&r are first used to achieve renewable &6Deepslate&r. This recipe runs at &9EV&r or higher.
moni.quest.5FB696EF1D2412F5.description4: After this, &3Macerators&r should pulverise the &9Deepslate&r into &9Deepslate Dust&r and a chance of &6Thorium&r. It is recommended to overclock this recipe as much as you can, in order to maximize the amount of &6Thorium&r you get.
moni.quest.5FB696EF1D2412F5.description5: A &3Centrifuge&r then turns &6Deepslate Dust&r into &6Biotite Dust&r and &6Silicon Dioxide Dust&r. The latter can be electrolysed, yielding &6Silicon&r and &6Oxygen&r.
moni.quest.5FB696EF1D2412F5.description6: &6Biotite Dust &ris then finally put into a &3Electrolyser&r. This yields &6Potassium, Magnesium, Aluminium&r and &6Silicon Dust&r, as well as some &6Fluorine&r.
moni.quest.5FE96C30454A0374.title: &9Tier Seven Micro Miner
moni.quest.601A47A727AC3BD2.description1: The final Nether Star tier. These will be used in &6Multidimensional CPU Wafers&r and &aUEV &6Emitters&r, &6Sensors&r, and &6Field Generators&r.
moni.quest.60B16BB064E2FF4C.description2: &2New in GTCEu, many organic substances offer the option of being Severely or Lightly cracked, as well as Hydro or Steam cracked, with each one granting different ratios of distillates.
moni.quest.616555E46F314F04.description1: &2Sodium Potassium is an alloy of… take a guess.
moni.quest.6169C04DF463502F.description3: Prioritize using these circuits to make things needed for unlocking the next theme of circuits, which require more infrastructure but are much cheaper to produce. Eventually each circuit tier through Tier Nine will have a Processor recipe instead of requiring Processor Assemblies, Supercomputers, or Mainframes.
moni.quest.6197C51E04761371.description1: &2Assembling Machines come early in CEu! Circuit recipes are handled through a separate machine, the Circuit Assembler.&r
moni.quest.6197C51E04761371.description2: Assembling Machines open up a plethora of &eequal or more efficient recipes that don't require hand tools&r. &2For example, you can make up to 4 Vacuum Tubes in a single craft! &rCheck &eEMI&r for all the components you've been making to see if the Assembler can improve their recipes.
moni.quest.6197C51E04761371.description4: Hand tool recipes also don't play nice with &bApplied Energistics&r. Take advantage of Assembling Machines: &cphase out all use of hand tools for crafting items in your automation going forward.&r Once you have all the important machines, you will never need hand tools for crafting.
moni.quest.6197C51E04761371.subtitle: Assembling Machine 1
moni.quest.6197C51E04761371.title: &2LV Assembling Machine
moni.quest.631F5DFF43F7A289.description1: The &6Extended Molecular Assembler&r is able to perform &a8 crafts at a time&r, and does each of those crafts &atwice as fast&r, meaning this assembler can do some serious work.
moni.quest.638130DC8A2BF1C1.description1: This is your first Micro Miner ever. You'll need &6Phosphorous&r in its &6LV Field Generators&r.
moni.quest.638130DC8A2BF1C1.description2: This Micro Miner is &6fully reusable&r, so you can send it on as many missions as you want.
moni.quest.638130DC8A2BF1C1.description3: To see what this Micro Miner can bring back, check its recipes in &bEMI&r.
moni.quest.63ADD9B48834AA39.description5: For now, a &3Vacuum Chest&r should help keep the floor clean, and will cause less lag than Hoppers. A &aVoid Upgrade&r in a &6Storage Drawer&r will automatically delete any items that overflow the drawer's capacity, so it's a good way to ensure you don't crash your server from accumulating a massive sugar cane pile before safer block breakers are available to you.
moni.quest.63CC578C3558E0AF.description1: The &3Hyperbolic Microverse Projector&r is the most powerful projector. It can perform all previous Micro Miner missions, as well as unlocking many new ones.
moni.quest.64AAF0CD958D836A.description1: &2GTCEu Fluid Pipes&r are now available, much improved from CE. Their advantage is higher &9throughput&r, but they have limitations on the kinds of fluids (&eacids, gases&r, etc) they can transport safely. Check each pipe material's tooltip for details. Fluid pipes do require a pump to be able to pull fluids from tanks or machines that lack an autooutput function, but &9ULV pumps (as well as other covers) are now buyable with Monicoins&r.
moni.quest.64AAF0CD958D836A.description3: You also have access to &9LaserIO&r, which allows for some extremely complex and compact filtering. LaserIO's nodes are wireless, have channels, can be overclocked, and allow for 9 cards per side.
moni.quest.64B52DA2ABD5152D.description2: Extruders are &2no longer strictly needed for Large Pipes.&r Extruders use ingots, but are as efficient for making &6Gears&r as melting and solidifying. They are also the most efficient way to make &6Bolts&r, &6Small Gears&r, and &6Rings&r.
moni.quest.64C33333ECCAABC7.description1: With some now-standard components you can upgrade a few &6Crystal Proessors&r into a &6Crystal Processor Assembly&r.
moni.quest.664107ED03A944CD.description1: The Third Micro Miner. &2You'll need Boron in its MV Field Generators.&r
moni.quest.664107ED03A944CD.description3: At this point in the game, Micro Miners can get you most basic resources, continue to check &bEMI&r to see what they can give you.
moni.quest.664107ED03A944CD.title: &2Tier Three Micro Miner
moni.quest.66FCC26399376B55.description6: Features new to &2CEu&r and quests with new content will be higlighted in &2dark green&r.
moni.quest.66FCC26399376B55.description7: Features new to &9Monifactory&r and quests with new content will be higlighted in &9Blue&r.
moni.quest.672D43BD113251EA.description3: Press &8R&r on the item you want to craft in the &bEMI&r and navigate to the &bScanner tab&r. This will tell you which item needs to be scanned to make the data for the new item. For example, &dLuV &6Electric Motors&r will require an &9IV&r &6Electric Motor&r to be scanned.
moni.quest.67663B49B80849C1.description1: &6Wetware Supercomputers&r are made in an &3Assembly Line&r at &cZPM&r or better power.
moni.quest.680C4363C268B223.description3: The &64k ME Storage Cell&r is the next size up. With four times the bytes it holds substantially more items per type, but it requires a more advanced technology than you currently have available: AE &6Processors&r made in an &3Inscriber&r.
moni.quest.6ABD83B58FADD4DF.description1: With &6Cryococcus&r and a bit of &6Californium&r, you can now upgrade craft the next tier of energy core, the &6Abyssal Energy Core&r.
moni.quest.6ABD83B58FADD4DF.description2: This core is directly used in the &6T8.5MM&r, but more importantly can be upgraded into a &6Hadal Energy Core&r.
moni.quest.6B908DECFA46C8E0.description1: The &3HV Circuit Assembling Machine&r unlocks &2the Mainframe. That's it.&r
moni.quest.6BF4A76C5B84EEE9.description1: The &6Tier Nine Micro Miner&r doesn't unlock any new items, but instead grants alternate sources for some pre-existing materials.
moni.quest.6BF4A76C5B84EEE9.description2: This miner is a great source of &6Plutonium 239&r, &6Darmstadtium&r, and &6Duranium&r. It is also a slightly slower but cheaper source of &6Neutronium&r compared to the &3Fusion Reactor MKIII&r.
moni.quest.6BF4A76C5B84EEE9.title: Tier Nine Micro Miner
moni.quest.6DAB13A7BDECE94E.description1: The &3Assembly Line&r is a large multiblock structure that crafts complex materials, similar to an &3Assembling Machine&r. These will be crucial going forward for making a variety of components and machinery.
moni.quest.6DAB13A7BDECE94E.description2: Make sure your power generation and circuit production are up to the challenge. &2None of the Assembly Line recipes require programmed circuits anymore.&r
moni.quest.6E27B9938B280291.description2: Use &9the Machine's GUI&r to relocate the output side of a machine where you want it to be, then press the "Auto Output" and "Permit Input" buttons, and put an ME Pattern Provider on that side of the machine.
moni.quest.6E27B9938B280291.description3: You can also permit input from the output side by shift-right-clicking with a screwdriver on the output side via the machine grid.
moni.quest.6E27B9938B280291.description5: Now, stuff the ME Pattern Provider with processing patterns. The next time you order an item, the ME Pattern Provider will push ingredients into the machine, and the machine will push outputs back into the Pattern Provider once they're ready, completing the craft. No need to use nodes or import buses!
moni.quest.6E27B9938B280291.description6: Furthermore, you can use Blocking Mode, which ensures that no items are in the inventory before placing the items in, which is a handy way to prevent conflicts. Even better, blocking mode now ignores Programmable Circuits and Molds! Please note that non-consumable items should stay in the machine, and not be included in the pattern made. Yes, this means you should make a separate machine for each non-consumable, at least until you get Large Machines.
moni.quest.6EA130B04FDE6868.description1: &6Omnium Coils&r are the final coil type you will need. At &a12600K&r, they're capable of smelting every material and make your EBF look &4f&6a&eb&au&2l&3o&9u&ds&5.
moni.quest.6F11E32BA70CA38C.description1: Bits of a &6Blitz Rod&r. Using a &3Macerator&r doubles your yield.
moni.quest.6F5BB99060FF03AC.description1: At this point, if you are not already using a &3Large Circuit Assembling Factory&r to perform your Circuit Assembler recipes, you really should be.
moni.quest.6FE459376BF7ABBA.description2: A simple chemical reaction with &9Water&r reprocesses it into the useful &9Sulfuric Acid&r, or it can be electrolyzed for recovering the &9Hydrogen&r.
moni.quest.70026930847E8EC0.description1: &n&9Monifactory&r&r compartilha um servidor oficial do Discord com outros projetos de Omicron Industries, o que serve como um recurso útil de comunidade.
moni.quest.70026930847E8EC0.description2: No servidor, há fluxogramas e guias para ajudar você com muitas partes do pacote, acessíveis por meio do bot do servidor, anúncios de desenvolvimento e muito mais estão disponíveis no canal &n#announcements&r, e a comunidade ajuda com perguntas de suporte técnico e investiga possíveis relatórios de bugs.
moni.quest.70026930847E8EC0.description3: Se quiser, você também pode conversar com outros jogadores, que estão dispostos a ajudar com dúvidas gerais.
moni.quest.70026930847E8EC0.rich_descrip: Para entrar no servidor, você pode usar o botão no Menu Principal para ir para a URL de entrada, ou se você não gosta do Discord, você pode encontrar outros projetos do autor do modpack em
O rastreamento e o desenvolvimento de problemas são tratados nos respectivos repositórios do projeto GitHub. O repositório para este pacote é
moni.quest.70026930847E8EC0.subtitle: o que é voltagem? posso comê-la?
moni.quest.70026930847E8EC0.title: Discord e GitHub
moni.quest.70784021A2D4E520.description1: &6Wrought Iron&r is a better alternative than &6Iron&r for tools, and with the &3Alloy Smelter&r you finally have a way to manufacture it, albeit slowly.
moni.quest.70784021A2D4E520.description2: First, you put Iron Ingots the &3Alloy Smelter&r with a &6Nugget Mold&r to create Iron Nuggets. Those Nuggets are then smelted in any &3Furnace&r to create &6Wrought Iron Nuggets.&r
moni.quest.70784021A2D4E520.description3: Finally, you can turn those &6Wrought Iron Nuggets&r into a &6Wrought Iron Ingot&r with another trip to the &3Alloy Smelter,&r or by &3Macerating&r them, combining the dust piles and another round of smelting in a &3Furnace.&r
moni.quest.70D9B3C6539720DE.description1: Now that you have &6HSS-G&r, you can begin automating &bExtended Crafting&r recipes in a easier way than before.
moni.quest.70D9B3C6539720DE.description6: While it might seem that the crafting process is slow, &ePackagedAuto is excellent at parallelizing&r. You can surround an Unpackager with Crafters and it will use all of them. It's also possible to add more Unpackagers with Crafters to keep up with the Packager, as long as the Holders are all the same.
moni.quest.713FAECEE5046121.description1: The multiblock uses energy cores to &erelease extremely large amounts of energy at once&r to craft things. While the batteries themselves are lost, you are able to recover some of the spent energy.
moni.quest.71C7B47DC85AA016.description2: These boards will enable the next tier of circuits, as well as a much cheaper method of circuit production.
moni.quest.7256E0064F967C93.description2: All SMD components must be produced in at least a &2HV Assembling Machine&r, and they all will require liquid &9Polyethylene&r.
moni.quest.7256E0064F967C93.description7: Finally, and new to CEu, SMD Inductors. Made with Nickel Zinc Ferrite and Fine Cupronickel Wire.&r
moni.quest.7256E0064F967C93.description8: Invest in a robust system of automation for SMD components and all of their ingredients, since you'll never stop needing them. They will also work in place of the non-SMD versions you've been using in all but the simplest of recipes.
moni.quest.7308924C9A481443.description1: &2Unique to this tier of Circuit, this MV circuit doesn't require the previous tier to craft.&r These are the best kind of Tier Two circuits you can make, and you won't unlock the better recipes for them until &9IV&r.
moni.quest.738A141D31AD7CE3.description3: Hope you've got those Tier Eight Micro Miners automated.
moni.quest.73908E06B75B9C9E.description1: Handling &6Patterns&r gets tedious pretty quickly, from not having enough slots to move tens of them at a time, to having to multiply them when upgrading your &3Large Machines&r, which, when equipped with &3Parallel Control Hatches&r, may require you to supply more than one item at a time to utilize them to their fullest.
moni.quest.73F8EA8E7DCC94E9.description4: The circuit progression has been largely replaced with the progression native to CEu, with a few minor changes to reflect the progression of this pack better.&r Check out the &9Progression quest book tab&r to see the flow of circuit progression.
moni.quest.74469710D910C19D.description1: &bPackagedAuto&r is an addon for &bApplied Energistics 2&r. Its main purpose in &5Monifactory&r is to allow you to eventually automate &bExtended Crafting&r recipes, but you may come up with other fun uses for it as well.
moni.quest.74469710D910C19D.description2: &bApplied Energistics 2&r stores recipes in &aPatterns&r, but so far they have been limited to at most 9 stacks of items as input (a standard 3x3 crafting grid). PackagedAuto stores recipes in &aPackage Recipe Holders&r, which don't have this limitation. Additionally, each Holder can store up to &e20 different recipes&r. Holders must be encoded in the &3Package Recipe Encoder&r.
moni.quest.74469710D910C19D.description7: &3Packager Extensions&r will act like a clone of an adjacent Packager - including access to patterns in its Package Recipe Holder - allowing you to craft recipe packages faster. Simply place the Packager Extensions around the Packager. Up to 26 extensions in a 3x3x3 cube around the Packager are supported.
moni.quest.74EDAE84246C7228.description2: The primary use is for making &2Cetane-Boosted Diesel&r, which you will want to stockpile in large quantities for the later production of &6Cryolobus &2(unless you use Gasoline instead).
moni.quest.74EDAE84246C7228.description4: &2It's more power efficient to use singleblock Distilleries over a Distillation Tower for Oil, due to the overclocking mechanics being different. However, it is still recommended to use Distillation Towers, to get the other useful byproducts too. For Diesel, the correct ratio is 3 Distilleries for Light Oil and 2 Distilleries for Heavy Oil.
moni.quest.754C416FB3F5DBDA.description2: The Fluid Solidifier tends to be the more efficient option: for example, you can use &e8 ingots&r to make one &6Gear&r in an Alloy Smelter, but with an Extractor and Solidifier you can accomplish the same result with &e4 ingots&r.

The Fluid Solidifier tends to be the more efficient option: for example, you can use &e8 ingots&r to make one &6Gear&r in an Alloy Smelter, but with an Extractor and Solidifier you can accomplish the same result with &e4 ingots&r.
moni.quest.75DD12FBC8AA39FC.description3: Now, all* &3Assembly Line&r recipes are available to you, given you have the &dCWU/t&r to research them. The most computationally demanding recipe needed to beat the pack, for the &6Extradimensional Mainframe&r, requires &d192 CWU/t&r.
moni.quest.7641AE777370BE1A.description2: The Distillation Tower is a highly flexible multiblock structure, able to be anywhere from &62 blocks high to 13 high&r (12 fluid outputs). The way that it works is that each level of the tower after the first will output an additional fluid from the recipe. &cIf the number of fluid outputs from the recipe exceeds the number of available hatches or those hatches are too small to hold the output, the recipe will not run&r.
moni.quest.7641AE777370BE1A.description3: What you need the Distillation Tower for initially is to break down &9Oil&r and &9Fermented Biomass&r into useful resources.&9 Oil&r distillation, with its four outputs, will require a &efive-block-high Distillation Tower&r (the quest materials are for such a tower; if you want to build it bigger, you will need &ean additional 7 casings and 1 fluid output per floor&r).
moni.quest.7641AE777370BE1A.description4: Any recipe with more than four output fluids (like &9Fermented Biomass&r) will need a larger tower. Make sure to increase the height of your tower to accommodate all of the outputs you want to keep. Also check the voltage requirements of the recipes, as many Distillation Tower recipes need higher voltages than MV. &eYou can swap out your Energy Input for a higher tier one when that time comes&r. Also, any recipe that has an item output will need an &6Output Bus&r, anywhere on the bottom layer.
moni.quest.7641AE777370BE1A.description5: The tower we'll be building at first is 3x3x5 (LxWxH), with a hollow center. The &6Fluid Input Hatch&r and &6Maintenance Hatch&r &2can go anywhere on the bottom layer&r. The &6controller&r goes in the middle of an outer edge of the bottom layer. The &6Energy Input Hatch&r can go wherever you can fit it on the bottom layer. The rest of the 3x3 must be filled with &6Clean Stainless Steel Casings&r.&2 Each level above that is a ring of 7 Clean Stainless Steel Casings, one &6Fluid Output&r and nothing in the center, except for the topmost layer which needs an eighth casing to fill in the center, capping off the top.
moni.quest.7641AE777370BE1A.description6: For distilling fluids which only have one useful output, like &9Biomass&r, it is recommended to use single-block Distilleries, due to their energy efficiency and generally lower costs.
moni.quest.776199B37A19A592.description1: &2In GTCEu, higher-tier blends of dusts require higher-tier Mixers to mix. The MV Mixer is required for making Vanadiumsteel and Stainless Steel.
moni.quest.77670BF761084AA2.description2: &2CEu circuit progression means you also have to put wires on your substrates for them to be usable. In this case, use some Fine Copper Wires.&r
moni.quest.785300684B1846B2.description1: The &2MV Assembling Machine&r allows you to craft &6Medium Voltage Coils&r, and your &3Laser Engraver&r can make &2Ultra Low Power ICs with a Sapphire Lens.&r
moni.quest.785C6332FC7A07A5.description4: &2Starting at EV, 4A Energy and Dynamo hatches are available at each tier.
moni.quest.78EB8574A67B10D4.description3: The easiest ways to get fish are via a &aGuardian Model&r from &bHNN&r, or using a &aGregtech Fisher&r.
moni.quest.7979D07FBDC6D170.title: &9Monic Processing Unit
moni.quest.7A09229ACC000B09.description2: It might seem crazy right now, but you'll want a dedicated &3Chemical Reactor&r for pretty much every chemical you want to process. You probably want to hold off on doing that until you've got a solid base with autocrafting though… it stings a lot less when you can just request crafts of Chemical Reactors from your AE2 system.
moni.quest.7C0A37EEA3C63B16.description1: Combining an &aI/O Bus&r and an &aME Interface&r into a single block, these can be used in place of &aInput&r and &aOutput Buses&r in GregTech multiblocks to connect them directly to your AE2 network.
moni.quest.7C0A37EEA3C63B16.description2: Note that only the Interface-textured side will connect to an ME network.
moni.quest.7C22CDB22492916F.description1: Taking a look at the &6Corrupted Universe Data&r has given you a couple of ideas, but to properly take advantage of it, a new Micro Miner is needed.
moni.quest.7C22CDB22492916F.description2: This Micro Miner requires an Epic Extended Crafting Table to fit all the things required for a foray into a corrupted universe.
moni.quest.7C22CDB22492916F.title: &9Tier Eleven Micro Miner
moni.quest.7C3B69B3DC09FE96.description2: If you don't want to go exploring for Cows, just buy a pair of "&6Spawn Cow&f" eggs and breed them. Seriously, spend your &9coins&f!
moni.quest.7DB174443D7FAFA0.description2: &6Enderium&r needs a lot of heat and is incredibly slow without overclocking. &2You can use small amounts of Krypton from Liquid Ender Air distillation to significantly decrease the smelting time.&r
moni.quest.7DB174443D7FAFA0.description3: &9Enderium also requires Tantalum, which can be renewably created by macerating and processing dragon scales.
moni.quest.7DB174443D7FAFA0.description4: As with all later blast furnace materials, dedicate a furnace to keeping these in stock and have it running constantly to ensure a stable supply (turning it off when you have an acceptably vast stockpile).
moni.quest.7E09D4E00BFA4970.description2: &2The HV Circuit Assembler only unlocks one circuit type, the Mainframe. There is no circuit theme associated with the HV Circuit Assembler; instead, the HV (non-Circuit) Assembler unlocks easier Circuit components. The next circuit theme is not until EV.
moni.quest.7E3A179376673590.description1: The &3Elite Microverse Projector&r is an even more powerful projector required for sending &6Tier Seven&r through &6Tier Ten Micro Miners&r into microverses.
moni.quest.7E51D15F38C3B356.description1: That's a lot of foil. &2These use Palladium Foil instead of Electrum now.&r
moni.quest.7E51D15F38C3B356.description2: These boards are required for &6Crystal Circuits&r, as well as the future basis of &6Wetware Lifesupport Circuit Boards&r. These will get you from tier five to tier eight.
moni.quest.7EA737163230F984.description1: A &aSoft Mallet&f can be used to temporarily stop a machine from functioning. While &9this can also be done by pressing the pause button within the machine's GUI&r, the Soft Mallet has a special function where &9it can pause the machine after it finishes it's current recipe&r if you &6sneak-right click&r it. This can be helpful if you are low on power, but is mostly useful when you need to upgrade a multiblock (more on those later).
moni.quest.7ECA688A91A1392A.description1: The &6Advanced System-on-Chip&r (or &6ASoC&r) unlocks the most efficient recipe for producing &6Nanoprocessors&r and &6Quantum Processors&r.
moni.quest.7ECA688A91A1392A.description2: The latter circuits must be made in a &3ZPM Circuit Assembler&r.
moni.quest.7F1EE712BD9CC811.description2: &r&6Tantalum&r is obtained from &6Tantalite Ore&r, or in small quantities from centrifuging &eLava&r.
moni.quest.7F1EE712BD9CC811.description3: &6Molybdenum&r is obtained from &6Molybdenum, Molybdenite, Powellite, and Wulfenite ores&r. They spawn together in the &eNether&r rarely, or some of them come from &3Tier One&r and &3Five Micro Miners&r.
moni.quest.7F669657313F2E62.description2: You can create it with &6Sculk Dust&r and either &6Black or Red Steel&r.
moni.quest.7FA0E6F3B466576C.description4: &3Smelt&f it into ingots, &ahammer&f it into &6Plates&f, and &acut&f them into &6Wires&f.
moni.quest.7FC4297F2BC90F55.description2: If you don't want to do that, or are having trouble finding one you need, feel free to etch them yourself with a &3Laser Engraver&r.
moni.chapter.0102198269F850CD.title: geração de energia
moni.quest.2BCE3E3E0B8180F7.description1: In &bMV&r, you unlock new gasses that are cheaper to produce or last longer in your generators. In particular, &9Wood Gas&r, &9Benzene&r and &9LPG&r are good options at this stage. You'll likely need one of them, as &6Advanced Gas Turbine Generators&r consume 4x as much fuel to generate 4x as much &eEU&r.
moni.quest.34876F54406B6A04.description1: &6Steam Turbine Generators&r are the easiest way to start generating &eEU&r with &bGregTech&r.
moni.quest.61301FBD825F8280.description1: After combining several dozen elements, or less efficiently, just throwing a bunch of &6Iron&r and &6Copper&r into the &3Omnic Synthesizer&r, you get &6Omnium Nuggets&r, those nuggets can be further compressed into an ingot form, workable like many of the metals that comprise it.
moni.quest.11124D8CC9403E67.description1: With your &2Omnium&r-based machine hulls, Assembling Machine built, and &6Dimensional Processor Mainframes&r squared away, you can finally get on the path to making a Ultra Extreme Voltage &3Circuit Assembling Machine&r.
moni.quest.34F0E33D33EB82E2.description2: If you're looking to get into power generation with a &6Gas Turbine Generator&r as early as &7LV&r, your best fuel options are &9Methane Gas&r centrifuged from &6Rubber Logs&r.
moni.quest.604CCBE824D03A74.description2: With over 50 uses for each tier of machine hull, you'll want to make a lot of these.
moni.quest.604CCBE824D03A74.description1: &9Machine Hulls&r, along with circuits, are used in nearly every &bGregTech&r machine.
moni.quest.62C85A1F451C4855.description4:
With a &3Tier Three Rocket&r you can make it to &eMercury&r and &eVenus&r. Before you go, make a &eNetherite Space Suit&r, otherwise the atmosphere will &cburn you to death&r.

Mercury has &6Argentite&r for &eIndium&r, &6Plutonium&r, and &6Laurite&r, as well as fluid veins of &9Blazing Pyrotheum&r, &9Sodium Persulfate&r, and… &9Mercury&r.
Venus has &6Xenotime&r, &6Gallite&r, &9Sulfuric Acid&r fluid veins, and lots of &6Platinum Group ores&r.
moni.quest.62C85A1F451C4855.title: &9…and let me play among the stars…
moni.quest.63812416270292A4.description2: In this age, you unlock the &3Hyperbolic Microverse Projector&r, which dramatically increases the rate at which Microverse missions can be sent. This enables you to make &6Infinity&r far faster than before, and access the element &6Necrosiderite&r.
moni.quest.0A34290F579BB4E2.description2: In this age, should spend some time to go back and remodel your base for higher throughput. From here on out, material demands will skyrocket and it's not fun to wait hours for autocrafts to finish!
moni.quest.1A6F087E10DC036E.description2: This accomplishment is more symbolic than previous ages, but it does allow you to transfer far more power in and out of your machines with &cMAX&6 Energy Hatches.&r
moni.quest.11124D8CC9403E67.description2: This tier of Assembling Machine unlocks &6Monic Circuits&r, as well as handling crafting recipes up to 8388608 EU/t. It can also optionally overclock recipes that consume up to 2097152 EU/t for improved speed at the cost of relatively more power.
moni.quest.6DBD1492197AC92D.title: &9Tier 2.5 Micro miner
moni.quest.6DBD1492197AC92D.description2: Each Tier 2.5 Mission requires &68 Quantum Flux, several buckets of lava&r, and &6a block&r corresponding to the type of mob drops it returns.
moni.quest.33F610CF136278AE.description3: This Micro Miner can be used to obtain &6Necrosiderite&r, &6Quasi-Stable Neutron Stars&r, and will be used later for making &6Extradimensional Circuits&r.
moni.quest.6DBD1492197AC92D.description3: This &9Micro Miner&r offers a way to easily get some basic &6Mob Drops&r.
moni.quest.51FD757E07E397A1.description1: The &3Simulation Quantum Computer&r functions identically to the &3Simulation Chamber&r, but can be overclocked with energy hatches to run faster with more energy. This multiblock can be useful if your resource generation has started lagging behind since unlocking &bHNN&r.
moni.quest.2C4500569586EBC7.description3: Using two of these, most multiblocks can be run at &dLuV&r voltage.
moni.quest.60A7102F5BA0DE19.description1: When sourcing &9Ethanol&r from &9Biomass&r, you should use a &3Distillery&r instead of a &3Distillation Tower&r - the extra &9Water&r byproduct is not worth the increased energy cost.
moni.quest.2C4500569586EBC7.description1: The &6Insane Voltage Coil&r required for this energy hatch will require both an &9IV&r assembler and &6Neptunium&r, obtained through processing depleted nuclear fuels.
moni.quest.7ACF867DECE1C37F.description1: Now that you have your &3Microverse Projector&r, you will need to project a microverse for the &6micro miners&r to use. This is done using &6Universe Creation Data&r and quite a bit of &6Quantum Flux&r.
moni.quest.1EA5F30C5ACADBA9.description4: If a Microverse does reach 0 Integrity, it will collapse, and the micro miner on the mission will be returned, but nothing else. You will have to project a new microverse to run more recipes.
moni.quest.38B1588655AA9BDF.description2: Shattered microverses cannot be repaired in any way. To run more missions, you must re-shatter a Normal microverse. When a Shattered microverse runs out of stability, it becomes a &3Corrupted Microverse&r.
moni.quest.05F7C3F397B329F5.description1: With two &9IV &6Energy Hatches&r on a &3Large Chemical Bath&r, you are now able to break down &6Rarest Metal Mixture&r, which you have been getting from your pre-existing Platline.
moni.quest.3E45F67F09B6156B.description2: Most Crucible recipes have a required initial color that the Crucible must be in for the recipe to run, and a Resulting Color that the Crucible will turn into once the recipe finishes. This information can be found in &bEMI&r. Some recipes 'increment' the Crucible's color, meaning the color moves that many spaces clockwise on the color wheel (see next page).
moni.quest.7C5CE283172CD952.description4: There are a limited number of available frequencies, so try to keep the number of fluid links below 16,777,216.
moni.quest.7D4B29BA4D8CB153.description1: While it is possible to obtain all your sculk from pillaging nearby Deep Darks or using micro miners, the demand for these items will only grow, so it is recommended to switch to using a &3Sculk Vat&r soon for all of your sculk needs.
moni.quest.3E45F67F09B6156B.description3: Additionally, there are two recipe modes the Crucible can be in: Chromatic Processing and Chromatic Transcendence. Just like how the Multi Smelter can be in either Furnace or Alloy Smelter mode, the Crucible can only be in one mode at a time. The Crucible works the exact same in both modes, the only difference is what recipes are available.
moni.quest.1EA5F30C5ACADBA9.description1: Tier 4+ Micro Miner missions that require the &3Advanced Microverse Projector&r are quite taxing on the projected Microverse. As the recipes run, the Integrity of the microverse depletes. The total depletion a recipe causes can be seen in &bEMI&r.
moni.quest.7C5CE283172CD952.description3: Frequencies are distinguished based on a 8 character hexadecimal color code. Optionally, you can give each frequency a description. In the top left of the link's GUI, you can find a button leading to a menu with a list of all available frequencies and their descriptions.
moni.quest.7ACF867DECE1C37F.description3: After projecting your microverse, the projector will change appearance, and you should be ready to send off your first microverse mission.
moni.quest.093883A81E6926E2.description1:
Harvest the growing &6Amethyst Clusters&6 with an &bApplied Energistics&r &3Annihilation Plane&r on a network that only has storage for &6Amethyst Shards&r.

You can grow the Amethyst faster with &bApplied Energistics&r &3Growth Accelerators&r, just like Budding Certus Quartz.
moni.quest.1CA3A00393EDD648.description2: Recipes run in the Vat will produce less and less output the farther the output hatch is from half full, producing the amount listed in &bEMI&r at exactly 50%% and up to 8x less as the hatch approaches completely empty or full. Note that the amount a recipe will produce is decided as soon as the recipe starts.
moni.quest.1C861E0C62D5B97D.subtitle: In the end, no answer is ever as elegant as its question
moni.quest.7ACF867DECE1C37F.description2: Looking at the Creation Data's uses in &bEMI&r, you'll see that it changes the microverse type to Normal. For quite a while, all micro miners will require the Normal microverse type to run.
moni.quest.1EA5F30C5ACADBA9.description3: Note that the above behavior is specific to Normal microverses. &eEach microverse type repairs in different ways&r, so make sure to ready their quests!
moni.quest.19084E91F357C8C2.description1: When fueled, the &3Transdimensional Energy Singularity&r grants unlimited energy to all machines and energy hatches, removing their need to push or pull power.
moni.quest.2D10F2E538486624.description9: On top of this, reactors get faster as they continuously run the same recipe. All recipes start out with double duration, but over time the recipes will eventually become twice as fast as listed in &bEMI&r.
moni.quest.4F08AF2C1E6B1736.description1: With &6Monium&r and &6Extradimensional Mainframes&r, you can make &cMAX&r &6Energy Hatches&r. A 16a &cMAX&r hatch provides 256x the power compared to a &aUEV&r one, if you can afford it.
moni.quest.485CEA4199AAD352.description3: HASoC chips grant access to cheaper &6Wetware Processors&r, but require a &3Circuit Assembler&r running &4UHV&r voltage.
moni.quest.114B300F56E48351.description1: This device shrinks your hitbox to a size specified in its gui, opened by shift-right-clicking. Very useful for fitting between cables and pipes!
moni.quest.415F2703877FBE21.description2: This is also one of the first automations you'll face in the &3Prismatic Crucible&r. While it is possible to make all your P.R.I.S.M by using a single Crucible and countless &6Chromatic Stabilizers&r, consider exploring alternate, cheaper sequences using multiple Glass or Crucibles alongside each other.
moni.quest.5CFBE0455A242AEB.description3: If you complete the tasks for a quest before you've completed its dependencies, the quest will display a gray check mark, and will be instantly completed when unlocked. These pre-completed quests won't count as completed for other quest that depend on it while locked.
moni.quest.4F08AF2C1E6B1736.description2: These hatches, along with the &3Transdimensional Energy Singularity&r and &6Omega Parallel Hatches&r, will allow you to scale your infrastructure to the insane levels needed to beat the pack.
moni.quest.0FD9B533BB402B17.description3: &6Ruined Hulls&r are more abundant than &6Ruined Machine Parts&r but gives less &6Necrosiderite&r overall. They also give high-end materials such as &6Neutronium&r, &6Tritanium&r, and &6Crystal Matrix&r
moni.quest.1CEFFF8EE1E4B6EE.description1: &6Neptunium&r can be obtained either through processing depleted nuclear fuels in a &3Fission Reactor&r, or through one the the &6Tier Four Micro Miner&r missions.
moni.quest.19084E91F357C8C2.description2: (Unique multi mechanic code taken from the Cosmic Frontiers team with Caitlynn's gracious permission.)
moni.quest.4FF4697A8AF10731.description2: If the 'automatic pulling' mode is enabled, ALL items/fluid on the network will be made available to the multiblock.
moni.quest.1BADB230EB1BEA4D.description2: Plutonium 239 can be mined as an ore on the planet Mercury. You will need a &6Tier 3 Rocket&r for this.
moni.quest.1BADB230EB1BEA4D.description3: Plutonium 241 can be obtained in dust form from a &6T5 Microminer&r mission, or in very small amounts from centrifuging Plutonium 239 dust.
moni.quest.1A427A8CB43C8B59.description1: - &lMachine Controler&r: Allows the enabling/disabling of machines or covers. Can also remove the ability or machines to pause themselves when out of power.
moni.quest.06794F93613F1496.description1: &6Oversize Interfaces&r have the same number of slots as &6Extended Interfaces&r, but each slot can hold up to 1024 items rather than 64.
moni.quest.436707C1C1A6A9DC.description2: Later, after building and running a &3Research Station&r, you will be able to make &6ME Pattern Buffer Proxies&r. They can be linked to a parent ME Pattern Buffer by Shift + Right-Clicking on the Buffer with a &6Data Stick&r then Right-Clicking on the Proxy with it. This will make it so the internal buffer of the Buffer is available to the Proxy, for use in another multiblock.
moni.quest.75810A27FBBBFB77.description3: Naquadah Chemistry yields large amounts of a variety of valuable resources. It can function as your primary source of radioactive elements such as &6Neptunium&r and &6Californium&r, as well as providing quite a bit of other advanced materials such as &6Tritanium&r, &6Darmstadtium&r, and &6Neutronium&r.
moni.quest.436707C1C1A6A9DC.description1: &6ME Pattern Buffers&r are unlocked after you obtain &6Europium&r. These blocks quite similarly to &6Pattern Providers&r, with some notable differences. These blocks are used in a multiblocks' structure as a hatch/bus. The items/fluids provided from paterns in the buffer are stored in an infinitely large internal storage. Each pattern has its own buffer, so no two patterns can mix ingredients. Additionally, catalyst items/fluids can be shared accross all patterns in the buffer.
moni.quest.75810A27FBBBFB77.description4: The midproducts of Naquadah Chemistry also have use in the making of Liquid &6Naquadah Fuels&r, made in the &3Naquadah Refinery&r. They can function as your primary power source for most of the rest of the pack.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description1: Transporting &aEU power &erequires caution&r. The key is to always &amatch or exceed&r the &eVoltage &rand&e Amperage&r of your power source with your &6cables&r and machines.
moni.quest.74A7ABF43D6A403F.description2: It is important to note that if you do not have the required hatches, the Terminal will leave holes for those hatches, causing the multiblock to not form.
moni.quest.3E1A349F989835F7.title: Photonic Chips
moni.quest.3E1A349F989835F7.description1:
It is easier to explain how &6Photonic Chips&r work in text rather than visually.

Imagine each Chip has three on/off levers for the Red, Green, and Blue colors. When a Chip is put into the Crucible, the lever(s) corresponding to the Crucible's colors are toggled. Secondary colors flip both of their primary components' levers.

For example, a Red Chip put into a green Crucible would output a Yellow Chip, because the green color flipped the green 'lever' on.
A magenta Chip put into a cyan Crucible would output a Yellow Chip, because the cyan color toggled both the blue lever Off and the green lever On.

In either case, the Crucible will be left in the state corresponding to the Chip's color &3at recipe start&r, or to the next primary color clockwise if the Chip was inert.
moni.quest.3E1A349F989835F7.description2: When a PSoC is put into the Crucible, the lever(s) corresponding to the Crucible's colors are toggled. Secondary colors flip both of their primary components' levers. Afterwards, the Crucible changes color to what the PSoC previously was.
